Package com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.commands.transform.handles

Class Handle

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.interact.cmd.commands.transform.handles.Handle
public class Handle extends Object
Represents a single, interactive 3D handle (gizmo) used for manipulating objects in the scene.

A handle is a visual component (e.g., an arrow or a cube) that the user can click and drag to perform a transformation (like translate, rotate, or scale) along a specific axis. This class encapsulates the handle's 3D position, its type (axis), its selection state, and the logic required to draw it on the screen.

Lehlogonolo Poole

      public Handle draw(Graphics2D g)
      Renders the handle on the screen.

      This method projects the handle's 3D position to a 2D screen point and executes the drawing logic. If the handle is selected, it also renders its name and any extra details.

      Parameters:
      g - The Graphics2D context to draw on.
      Returns:
      This Handle instance.
